evidence: REACHABILITY. Runtime: task/environment/Dockerfile (identical to template) provides node:22-bookworm-slim with express@5.1.0 and better-sqlite3@12.4.1 under NODE_PATH; instruction.md:15 'Server dependencies are already available, so don't install packages' and integration.md:3-4 restrict to those packages plus Node built-ins. Every graded capability is buildable with them: sessions and password hashing via node:crypto, live updates by polling or SSE (hireops_rules.md:129 'Polling, server-sent events and sockets are all fine'), drafts in browser storage ('Where drafts are kept is up to you', :182). The golden shows it: solution/app requires only express, better-sqlite3 and node built-ins (src/index.js:16-19, db.js:5-7, bootstrap.js:3-4) and package.json pins the same versions. Raw evidence (hashes re-verified; all matching_source_files equal the frozen bytes): workspace.json 26/26 scripted groups PASS, installed via solve.sh, covering paging 30 at a time, stale 409 naming who, bulk all-or-none, undo semantics, unread/seen, drafts across session end and restart without reseed, in a verifier image whose tests/Dockerfile pins the same node 22 / express 5.1.0 / better-sqlite3 12.4.1. SEED. Every seeded fact the criteria quote is present: users/roles match instruction.md:19 and app_context.md:10-19; JOB-PLAT Applied APP-105,106,108 (Greta Lindqvist, Ade Bello, Marco Rossi) and Screen APP-103,104 (Priya Nair, Samuel Ortiz); APP-101 note 'Strong systems answers; weaker on incident follow-up.'; APP-101 has 120 messages (four pages of 30, thread_page_size=30); Lena APP-301 has 3 messages, her read_count is 2 and the third is from USR-REC3, so the seeded unread count is 1 as hro_unread_seen expects; Noor APP-101 INTERVIEW / APP-302 APPLIED and Tomas APP-201 SCREEN give the quoted candidate wordings through candidate_status_labels; APP-301 carries rejected_from and reject_reason. The password Hireops!2026 is stated in instruction.md:19 and hireops_rules.md:11 (the seed has no password field, so the brief is the only source, and it is there). instruction.md:17 states /assets and /instructions are unavailable at runtime and to copy what is needed. NETWORK: allowed per the workbook's public row and the SKILL delivery profile; the brief only optionally allows browser CDN use (instruction.md:15), so even the internal sheet's older 'no network' wording would be met - nothing graded needs the network. Judge prompts use only http://localhost:3000 (lesson 13 checked; grep found no other address apart from the frozen OpenRouter env). ONE READING / NO HIDDEN DEMANDS (lesson 1 checked for every criterion leg in functional, polish and both gates). Each graded behaviour maps to explicit public text: one-stage moves and skip refusal (rules:48-49); blank reason, reopen only to rejected-from stage, reason cleared (49-51); Hired not rejectable (49); arrive at bottom (57-58); up/down re-order persisting (58-60); places a whole number 1-50 (28-29), covering 0/51/2.5; manager from hiring-manager accounts (29-30), covering recruiter-as-manager; email shape, case-insensitive duplicate, error at the field, form kept (33-36); Interview cap including reopen and undo (64-66, 101-102); manager late-stage rules incl. re-order and reject/reopen (71-73); 409 naming who (78-82); optimistic move, put back, reason, focus on the card (86-88); bulk board order, all-or-none, places for the whole set (92-95); undo scope, once, latest only, note exception, overfill (99-104); Activity lines, newest first, job filter, refusals leave no line (115-119); 15 s live updates preserving typing, focus, open card and scroll (123-129); conversation roles (137-141); plain text, blank, Enter/Shift+Enter, focus, failed send kept (145-147); 30-message paging with remaining count and stable top message (151-154); unread definition, sending counts as reading, scrolled-up notice (158-167); seen rules, observer never counts (171-173); drafts per user and conversation through switch, reload and session end with sign-in prompt (177-182); note drafts per user (110-111); candidate list fields, wording, no auto-open, forbidden data (186-203); 401/403/404 semantics (22-24). Interpretive points probed and found single-reading: (a) Z is not undoable after undoing A2 in hro_undo step 5 - rules:103-104 'once I make a later move, my earlier one is no longer undoable' rules out an undo-stack reading; (b) a refused undo does not consume the undo - 'turned down and nothing changes' (101-102), needed by hro_interview_places; (c) whether a re-order is itself an undoable 'move' is unstated, but no expected outcome depends on it (hro_undo steps 2-5, hro_interview_places and hro_activity give the same result either way); (d) the ABA stale replay in hro_two_people is unambiguous because rules:78-79 require a version that changes whenever the card moves; (e) candidate 403 vs 404 is accepted either way by hro_readonly_roles and fixed to 404 for another application's conversation/send by rules:24. Weak-app probe: an app that checks staleness by from-stage only passes the ABA replay and is correctly failed by public text. Conforming-alternative probe: an app whose undo request carries no move id, whose UI hides forbidden targets, or which refuses a full-Interview move before moving the card, is accommodated by functional/prompt.md:25 and the hro_interview_places alternatives, so it is not failed for a non-public reason. OBSERVATION (minor wording, recorded because the row reports every ambiguity; not a defect): hireops_rules.md:18 role table says a Hiring manager 'works the late stages of their own jobs, writes notes there'; 'there' could be read as late stages only, while hireops_rules.md:109 states 'a hiring manager writes notes on cards of their own jobs', and hro_manager_roles lets the judge pick any J1 card for Ingrid's note. The specific section-3 sentence and the parallel 'joins those conversations' (own jobs) make the own-jobs reading the reasonable one, and the golden (src/index.js:394) implements it. Low likelihood that a conforming app fails. No unreachable item found.
suggested_fix: Optional wording tightening only (not required for Pass): change hireops_rules.md:18 to 'works the late stages of their own jobs and writes notes on any of their cards' so the role table cannot be read as late-stage-only notes.
